page.overview:
Who is Calib Bronn?

Calib Bronn was a petty nobleman from Haakland considered one of the finest warriors in all his country. That lasted until he decided to hunt down Aguara, the monster that ultimately ended his life. She created very strong illusion of pack of angry endregas that killed him.
